scripts.build:engine: bunx --bun wasm-pack build crates/engine-wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../packages/comb/wasm --out-name engine --no-pack
scripts.build: bun run build:engine && bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/metric-tree build
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && bun test packages/comb/src && bunx --bun playwright test
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && bunx --bun eslint . && bunx --bun prettier --check .
scripts.example: bun run build:engine && bun run dev
